description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” illustrates the runtime (in seconds) for a set of models, contrasting “Our Joint Framework” with several “LLM Models.” The horizontal axis contains the model categories in left-to-right order: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude, with labels angled; no explicit x-axis label is shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Runtime (seconds)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 with regularly spaced tick marks at 50-second intervals, and light dashed gridlines aligned to these ticks. There are five single (non-stacked, non-grouped) bars: “Our Joint Framework” is shown in dark green with an annotated value of 77 seconds; the remaining four bars are light blue (as indicated by the legend for “LLM Models”) with annotated values of 190 seconds for ChatGPT, 365 seconds for DeepSeek, 172 seconds for LLaMA, and 243 seconds for Claude. The bars are not presented as sorted by value or alphabetically, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the color coding and the numeric value labels placed above each bar.
